How do I place an order?
Choose a product or lab test, add it to your cart and complete the checkout with your address. This demo does not place real orders.
This prototype offers a simulated payment step. Live UPI, cards and cash-on-delivery can be connected through a payment provider.
How can I track my order?
Open Profile → My Orders to see your order and its current status.
Can I return or exchange a product?
Return eligibility depends on the product and its condition. The policy displayed here is sample content.
Demo orders show an estimated delivery of 2–3 days. Lab bookings use your selected collection slot.

How can I contact customer support?
Open Profile → Customer Support to try our demo support conversation.
